Tom always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Anna keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. In fact, a bug hotel stacks canes and cones.

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The goose chased the children out of the yard.
Anna's dream job is to be a driver. The river bank looked quieter than usual that evening. On Friday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. In fact, the old train runs on coal.

The experience taught Anna more than any book could. People around Anna often share different ideas about the river bank. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. A high pressure system is parked overhead.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Anna ordered soup and juice at the plant garden last night. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams.
